summary: AssistantLayoutMode gains 'fullscreen' and useAssistantLayout() gains restoreMode(). AssistantShell renders full screen as a modal and offers it when its modes list includes 'fullscreen'.
howTo: Add 'fullscreen' to AssistantShell/AssistantWorkspace modes. setMode('fullscreen') opens full screen, restoreMode() or Escape returns to defaultMode. Code that switches exhaustively over AssistantLayoutMode or uses Record<AssistantLayoutMode, …> must handle 'fullscreen'.
